method: adb -s <device> shell dumpsys activity activities (resumed game activity only)
adb -s <device> shell dumpsys package com.DefaultCompany.urp_2d (version fields only)
scope: Read-only observation of the game already launched by the user. No automated input, restart, reinstall, save modification, rotation, background transition, or network-setting change.
limitations: Not a controlled fresh-install or offline startup test
No direct GameDataStore state query; only the visible gameplay screen was observed

logObservation.note: Native/OS error and warning lines are preserved; their gameplay impact is not established. Absence of signatures applies only to the collected process log.
